title: AI-assisted hardware design and verification
summary: Research on hardware design and verification using LLMs and AI agents.

title: Understanding Power9 performance
summary: CPI breakdown analysis for a clearer view of CPU bottlenecks.
problem: Identify where execution time is spent on IBM Power9.
contribution: Focused my master’s project on an LDMS-Sampler analysis framework.
methods: CPI breakdown, LDMS sampling, IBM Power9.
result: Completed a master’s project at NMSU in May 2023 describing the analysis framework.

title: BB-ML: predicting GPU execution
summary: Machine learning for basic block execution counts.
problem: Estimate execution counts for large inputs without profiling every configuration.
contribution: Contributed to basic block count prediction using NVBit-supported PPT-GPU.
methods: GPU instrumentation, machine learning, benchmark workloads.
result: Co-authored BB-ML, accepted at ICPADS 2023. The paper evaluates prediction across 16 GPU benchmarks.

title: GPU tracing for PPT-GPU
summary: Tracing tools for GPU performance modeling.
problem: Collect execution and memory behavior to support GPU performance prediction.
contribution: Collaborated with Los Alamos National Laboratory on reuse-distance and memory-tracing toolkits.

title: Hardware validation with ASMD
problem: Check hardware behavior against its intended control and data paths.
contribution: Debugged and verified hardware using an Algorithmic State Machine with Data Path diagram.

title: Cache memory simulator
summary: A C++ simulator for exploring cache organizations.
problem: Model memory accesses across different cache configurations.
contribution: Implemented programs for direct-mapped and set-associative caches.
result: Built a configurable cache simulation implementation.

title: MIPS compiler project
summary: Exploring compilation with abstract syntax trees.
problem: Translate program structure into a MIPS implementation.
contribution: Created a MIPS implementation using an abstract syntax tree for Compiler Transition.

title: An 8-bit computer
summary: A Simple As Possible computer simulated in Proteus.
problem: Explore the organization of a small, complete computer.
contribution: Designed an 8-bit microcomputer with 64 KB of main-memory support.

title: General-purpose shift register
summary: A small digital design with multiple data-movement modes.
problem: Support left shift, right shift, and parallel loading.
result: Produced the register design with the three operating modes.

title: Secure offline IoT automation
summary: Local monitoring and control when internet connectivity is unavailable.
problem: Keep appliance monitoring and control available during internet outages.
contribution: Worked with Team Hawkbit on desktop software and a sensor network; presented the paper at WiSPNET 2019.
methods: MQTT, Python, sensor networks, a shared control dashboard.
result: Built and demonstrated a supershop automation system with BUET and ACI Logistics; published the resulting paper.

title: Connected home automation
summary: An app to control lights, fans, and their operating levels.
problem: Remotely control light brightness and fan speed.
contribution: Worked with Team Hawkbit on the Android interface and connected hardware.
methods: MIT App Inventor, Google Firebase, IoT.
result: Won Battle of Hardware (IoT) at BUET CSE Festival 2018.

title: Smart waste monitoring
summary: Connected bins that notify collectors when service is needed.
problem: Communicate bin status and collection needs.
contribution: Worked with Team Hawkbit on cloud-connected bin monitoring and SMS alerts.
methods: IoT sensors, cloud data, SIM808 GSM messaging.
result: Built the hackathon prototype; received an honorable mention at CISCO Bangladesh’s 2018 IoT hackathon.

title: Indoor wayfinding wearable
summary: A wearable project for people with Alzheimer’s disease.
problem: Support finding a path inside a house.
contribution: Built a wearable device for indoor wayfinding.
